result.summary: 本文训练了 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，以零样本、单样本和少样本方式在大量 NLP 数据集上评估其性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上取得较强表现，少样本设置下有时可与先前最先进的微调方法竞争甚至偶尔超越 [abstract][S1.p11]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍然表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法论问题 [abstract][S1.p13]。此外，论文发现 GPT-3 生成的新闻文章让人类评估者难以与人类撰写的文章区分，并讨论了其更广泛的社会影响 [abstract][S1.p12]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定任务的标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。作者认为去除这一限制是可取的，因为许多有用任务难以收集大规模监督训练数据，且微调范式可能利用训练数据中的虚假相关、泛化到分布外表现较差 [S1.p3][S1.p4]。此外，人类通常只需简短指令或极少量示例即可学习新语言任务，作者希望 NLP 系统也具备这种灵活性和通用性 [S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: However, a major limitation to this approach is that while the architecture is task-agnostic, there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
to achieve strong performance on a desired task typically requires fine-tuning on a dataset of thousands to hundreds of thousands of examples specific to that task
For many of these tasks it is difficult to collect a large supervised training dataset, especially when the process must be repeated for every new task.
the potential to exploit spurious correlations in training data fundamentally grows with the expressiveness of the model and the narrowness of the training distribution
humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
To be broadly useful, we would someday like our NLP systems to have this same fluidity and generality.

method.text: 论文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，其规模是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍，并采用与 GPT-2 相同的模型和架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式 [abstract][S2.SS1.p1]。作者还训练了从 1.25 亿到 130 亿参数不等的 8 个不同规模模型，以研究性能对模型规模的依赖 [S2.SS1.p1]。评估时 GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定，分为少样本、单样本和零样本三种设置 [abstract][S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
We use the same model and architecture as GPT-2, including the modified initialization, pre-normalization, and reversible tokenization described therein
we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer, similar to the Sparse Transformer
we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
For all tasks, GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model.
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”, or in-context learning where we allow as many demonstrations as will fit into the model’s context window

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。训练数据主要来自经过过滤和去重的 Common Crawl，并加入 WebText、两个书籍语料和英文维基百科等高质量数据集 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。作者还系统研究了数据污染问题，构建保守的“干净”基准子集并比较原始分数与干净子集分数 [S1.p15][S4.p5][S4.p6]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation to tasks unlikely to be directly contained in the training set
For each task, we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”
we downloaded and filtered a version of CommonCrawl based on similarity to a range of high-quality reference corpora
we added several curated high-quality datasets, including an expanded version of the WebText dataset
we develop systematic tools to measure data contamination and quantify its distorting effects
For each benchmark, we produce a ‘clean’ version which removes all potentially leaked examples
We then evaluate GPT-3 on these clean benchmarks, and compare to the original score.

findings.text: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与最先进的微调模型竞争甚至偶尔超越 [S1.p11]。例如在 CoQA 上零样本达到 81.5 F1、单样本 84.0 F1、少样本 85.0 F1；在 TriviaQA 上零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2% [S1.p11]。GPT-3 还在解乱词、算术运算和仅见一次定义后使用新词等即时推理任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力 [S1.p12]。同时，论文发现部分任务即使 GPT-3 规模下少样本表现仍不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。在新闻生成方面，人类评估者区分 GPT-3 生成文章与人类撰写文章的准确率仅略高于随机水平，约 52% [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。

evidence.quote: on NLP tasks GPT-3 achieves promising results in the zero-shot and one-shot settings, and in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting
GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting

GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning, which include unscrambling words, performing arithmetic, and using novel words in a sentence after seeing them defined only once.

we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3. This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$

limitations.text: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如在文档级别语义重复、长段落失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。GPT-3 在“常识物理”问题上似乎特别困难，并且在比较类任务（如 WiC 和 ANLI）以及部分阅读理解任务上单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机 [S5.p2]。作者还指出结构性和算法性局限：实验未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能以牺牲某些任务性能为代价 [S5.p3]。此外，作者承认预训练样本效率差、少样本学习是否真正“从零”学习新任务存在不确定性，以及大规模模型推理昂贵且不便 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves, and occasionally contain non-sequitur sentences or paragraphs
GPT-3 seems to have special difficulty with “common sense physics”
it does little better than chance when evaluated one-shot or even few-shot on some “comparison” tasks
our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
Thus our design decision comes at the cost of potentially worse performance on tasks which empirically benefit from bidirectionality.
Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training.
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on
